name: @gjsify/sab-native-darwin-x64
description: darwin-x64 prebuilt native library + GObject-Introspection typelib for @gjsify/sab-native. Installed automatically on darwin/x64 as an optionalDependency of that package (ADR 0017) and skipped everywhere else. Contains no JavaScript.

platformsUncommitted.darwin-x64: prebuilds.yml's `build-prebuilds-macos` job builds and load-tests it; `commit-prebuilds` lands the first artifact on main after the ADR 0013 macOS port merges
